programs.title: The Neighbor Who Saw Too Much
programs.desc: A grounded teen becomes convinced that her hot new neighbour is actually a dangerous killer. When no-one else believes her, she takes matters into her own hands.

programs.title: A Pickleball Christmas
programs.desc: After winning the biggest match of his career, professional tennis phenom Luke Hollis is ready to hang up his racket and take over family's tennis club.

programs.title: Got To Leave Something
programs.desc: They meet the finest biker of Jiri Mountain, a poet who fled city life to live in the mountains. From this poet, who captures photos of stars and flowers, the two actors learn poetry.

programs.title: Theresa Caputo: Raising Spirits
programs.desc: When a horrible tragedy befalls someone close to her, Theresa continues to deliver messages while experiencing her own grief. Things get intense when the victim of tragedy makes himself known to Theresa.

programs.title: The Mother Flip
programs.desc: Kristy and Rebecca hike up their favourite nature trail to get a bird's-eye view of a potential flip in the community of Wimberley, Texas, which is known for its big-city wealth and small-town charm.

programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: Contestants must cook a dish using all nine ingredients in Poh's Everything Mystery Box. The winner scoring themselves $5,000 to spend at Harvey Norman, the bottom three head straight into Pressure Test.

programs.title: Global Soul Kitchen
programs.desc: Chef Deborah combines French cuisine with deep Southern cooking in her take on bouillabaisse. She starts by making a homemade broth with fish remnants, vegetable scraps, spices and more in a pot.

programs.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
programs.desc: Liz and Chris have both enjoyed living near the ocean and want to provide their three kids with the same experience. However, they have different opinions on how much to spend to make this dream a reality.

programs.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programs.desc: Living in Tuscany allows for the enjoyment of a long truffle season. Rachael shows how to use local truffles to add amazing flavour to a decadent dish of scrambled eggs and potato chips.

programs.title: Ppang Car Road 2
programs.desc: From Seoul to Busan, this spectacular eating show takes place at famous bakeries/patisseries to give the dessert lovers the glimpse of tasty goodness of some of the most-coveted desserts of all.

programs.title: Jake Makes It Easy
programs.sub_title: Everything Bagel Galette & Upside Down Banana Bread
programs.desc: Bagels get elevated from a breakfast dish to a perfect anytime meal with this everything bagel galette with heirloom tomatoes. The spin on a favourite is combined with a chocolate-filled banana bread.

programs.title: Theresa Caputo: Raising Spirits
programs.desc: An unassuming night out with her girlfriends yields one of the most emotional and surprising readings, as Theresa delivers messages to a skeptical woman grieving the shocking loss of her pregnant daughter.
